title: Rivet-Fist Laborer
text: Rivet-Fist Laborer continues a long-abandoned construction order by hammering trespassers into the floor. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The shift ended generations ago. The labor did not.

defeatReward.text: Rivet-Fist Laborer is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
